kinds.cards: Cards: self, it, a bound name, a filter with a zone, or { top: N, of: filter } (or `bottom: N`, the last N of an ordered area), with `also: filter` for those of the N that match.
kinds.filter: A filter of the card language, with the ruleset's own words also, from, has_window, given_to, counter (the Counter a card has now), base_counter (the one it prints) and not_forbidden (no prohibition forbids that event for the card, by the card whose effect asks: `not_forbidden: rested`).
kinds.value: A number: an integer, a count, a stat of a card, a difference, a variable, or a field of a bound event.
kinds.condition: A condition of the card language, or one of equal, allowed, can_activate, moved, flagged, given (`given: $param`: the card wrote that param).
kinds.player: you or opponent, as seen by the player the steps run for.
kinds.destination: An area, or a destination word of zones.yaml.
kinds.window: A window that actions.yaml gives actions to, or that a card ability names.
kinds.question: A question of the list below.
kinds.expiry_point: A point at which durations.yaml lets a duration end; or { at: point, cards: cards }, which ends only the effects there that apply to one of those cards; or { at: point, kept: true }, which runs only the steps kept for that point (`schedule`), while the other effects that end there still hold.
kinds.procedure: A procedure of procedures.yaml or a flow of flow.yaml.
kinds.variable: A variable: `flow.name` ends with that flow, `game.name` lasts; with `of`, one per player.
kinds.name: A new name for the steps that follow.
kinds.names: Words a player can answer with.
kinds.pattern: Fields of an event and what each must match, written as in `prohibit`.
kinds.args: The params of the procedure that is run, each with its value.
kinds.word: A word that is stored and compared, nothing more.
kinds.limits: The limits of a choice, as a card's pick writes them: distinct names, a total cost or a total power (`$take.limits`).

counter_to_attacked_only.name: Counters go to the card attacked
counter_to_attacked_only.does: A Character card's Counter gives its power to the card being attacked, with no choice of another.

open_cards.name: Open cards
open_cards.does: Every card is shown to both players all game, as at game over: secret areas are open. For learning and teaching.

stacked_decks.name: Stacked decks
stacked_decks.does: The decks are not shuffled before the game: each is drawn in the order its list gives, first card on top. For lessons, whose every draw is set out in advance.

move.does: Move cards to an area of their owner. A card that changes area becomes a new card (3-1-6 says so for the Character and Stage areas; the engine does it for every area); DON!! cards given to it go back as zones.yaml says (6-5-5-4). Unless the step says otherwise the card arrives active (3-7-5, 3-8-4, 3-9-3) and on top of an ordered area (3-5-2). A card arrives face-down in a secret area; with `face: up` it arrives face-up and is treated as a card of an open area (3-10-2-1); a card that moves within its area keeps its face (3-10-3). With `event`, each card's move is announced as that event, with the fields card, player (its owner), cause and by. `unaffected` skips the check and replace stages. Several cards going to an ordered secret area together are put in order by their owner (3-1-7), or by the player `order` names.

set_face.does: Turn cards of a secret area face-up or face-down where they are. A face-up card is treated as a card of an open area (3-10-2-1); a card already so is left alone (1-3-2-1).

set_state.does: Rest cards or set them active, announcing the event events.yaml gives for that state. A card already in that state is left alone (1-3-2-1).

attach.does: Give DON!! cards to a card in an area that takes them. A given DON!! card is neither active nor rested (4-4-2). With `event`, each DON!! card given is announced as that event, with the fields card (the card it is given to), player (that card's owner), cause and by.

shuffle.does: Put an area in random order, using the random-number state kept in the game. Nobody knows the cards of a secret area afterwards.

look.does: Show cards of a secret area to one player. The cards stay where they are (11-3-2).

modify.does: Add to a number of a card, set its base value, or set the number itself (`set`). Read through the derived-value steps below. `play_cost` is what playing the card from hand costs (4-7-1): its cost and these changes, never below 0. `counter` is the Counter the card has (2-10-1): the one it prints and these changes, or, while a number is set (`set`), the highest one set, whatever it prints or is given (card Q&A, OP16-118, OP17-063). `placed_don` is how many of the DON!! cards its player places in the DON!! Phase are given to it (6-4; OP13-003): 0 and these changes. A one-shot effect fixes the cards it changes, unless they are named by a filter: then it changes whatever cards the filter finds while it lasts.

grant.does: Give cards a keyword of keywords.yaml, or an attribute besides their own (2-5-2; OP15-093), which every filter and timing then reads.

prohibit.does: Forbid the events that match: the step names the event and the fields to match. An action that would cause such an event is not legal. A prohibition beats an instruction (1-3-3). With `unless`, the event is allowed for a price: those steps, run as a cost for the player of the effect that set it, are paid as the event happens; while they cannot be paid in full, the event is forbidden (OP08-043). With `only`, fields of the event and what each must match, written as the step's own: of the events the step matches, it forbids those `only` does not match ("cannot attack any card other than X"). Such prohibitions of the same event combine: an event that several of them match is forbidden unless the `only` of one of them matches it (official Q&A, OP17-044). A prohibition without `only` still forbids what it matches.

exempt.does: Lift one rule effect of rule_effects.yaml for the cards named; with `when`, only for events whose fields match. It lifts nothing a card forbids.

replacement.does: Start a replacement effect that lasts: an event that matches `replace` and happens to one of the cards, fixed as it starts, is offered to be replaced as a replacement ability's would be, by the steps `with`, which the effect's player runs (`optional`: asked first). It is an effect of the card that made it, which need not stay where it was (card Q&A, EB02-030).

invalidate.does: Make effects of one timing invalid for a player: they do not occur, ask nothing and cost nothing (8-2-1-1). With `cards` instead, the cards' own effects are invalid while it lasts: their printed abilities and keywords do not work, nor the names their text says they are also treated as (`names`, 2-1-3; Hunter); what other cards give them still works.

expire.does: End the effects whose duration ends at this point of the flow, the turn player's first. With `cards`, only those that apply to one of the cards: a change that a play uses up. With `kept`, only the steps kept for the point, which run then.

emit.does: Announce an event of events.yaml: the step names the event and gives its fields. It goes through the pipeline: a replacement may change its fields or take its place, and auto effects are collected from it. With `as`, the steps that follow read the event as it ended up; `happened` is false when it was prohibited or replaced, and its numbers then read 0.

flag.does: Record that a player has met a condition that checks.yaml judges.

open_window.does: Let a player take actions of actions.yaml until one closes the window. `once` closes it after one action. Waiting effects resolve after each action.

activate.does: Activate the ability of a card that belongs to a window: conditions, then the cost, then the steps (8-4-1). With `cost: ask` the player is asked before the cost is paid; without it, the player has already chosen by declaring the effect.

drain.does: Let the waiting auto effects whose timing was met by the named event resolve now, by the ordering below; with `player`, only that player's. The flow resolves all waiting effects by itself after each step and each action; a procedure writes this where some must resolve earlier. It does nothing while an effect is being resolved (8-6-3).

end_game.does: End the game with a winner. The players who lose by checks.yaml are found by the judge stage.

schedule.does: Keep steps for later, as part of the effect that is resolving: when the flow reaches the point where the duration `lasts` ends, they run for the same player, the turn player's first. A card that has changed area since is a new card (3-1-6), so `self` then names nothing.

random.does: Pick a player at random, using the random-number state kept in the game.

choose.does: A player chooses cards: `count` means as many as possible up to that number, `max` means up to. Asked only when there is more than one possible answer. A choice from an area the chooser cannot see is made blind. With `how`, a number is chosen: `any` takes that many cards of an area without order, where the cards are alike; `top` takes them from the top of an ordered area, `bottom` from its bottom; `don` takes that many DON!! cards, split over active, rested and given ones. Cards that a lasting effect names stand apart from the rest (a DON!! card kept rested through the next Refresh Phase, OP07-026): with `any` or `don`, when the cards offered are not all alike, the player then says which (choose_don).

ask.does: A player answers a question of the list below: yes or no, a number (from `min`, up to `max` when it says one), or one of the options.

if.does: Run `do` when the condition holds, `else` when it does not.

repeat.does: Run the steps a number of times; zero or less means not at all (1-3-2-2).

for_each.does: Run the steps once for each card, in the order given.

bind.does: Give a name to cards or to a number for the steps that follow. A name follows its card when the card moves.

run.does: Run a procedure of procedures.yaml or a flow of flow.yaml with the values given.

as_player.does: Run the steps with `you` meaning the player named. `each` runs them for both players, the turn player first.

if.does: Run the steps under it when the condition holds. Everything after an "If" is under it.

may.does: Ask the player; run the steps on yes. `if_you_do` then runs only if those steps changed something.

choose.does: Make one pick and bind it to a name that several steps use.

one_of.does: Ask the player which mode to carry out, and run that one. With `by: opponent`, the other player chooses the mode; the steps stay the effect's player's.

run.does: Activate another ability of the same card by its id: its conditions and its cost apply (general Q&A on OP03-074).

if_you_do.does: Run the steps under `do`, asking nothing; `if_you_do` then runs only if they changed something: "Play up to 1 .... If you do, ..." (OP-08 Q&A, OP08-098).

pipeline.does: Build the event: what changes, why, and which card or rule asked.
Drop what is impossible (1-3-2) or prohibited (1-3-3; by a card against a rule, 1-3-1) and record it.

Offer the replacement effects that match: first those of the card that caused the event, then the turn player's, then the other player's; a player with several chooses the order; each at most once, and never while its own steps run. A replacement's steps name the card of the event as `$replaced`. One use takes the place of the same event for every card of the same move it matches, and one refusal refuses them all (card Q&A, OP05-001 and OP05-030).
Record the event and what each player may see of it.
Queue the auto effects whose timing matches and whose conditions hold now.
Work out the permanent effects again, the turn player's first, until nothing changes.

impossible_is_skipped.does: A step that cannot be done is skipped and the rest still runs.

as_many_as_possible.does: A fixed number means as many as possible up to that number.

up_to_may_be_zero.does: `up_to` lets the player choose fewer, or none.

secret_choice_may_be_fewer.does: A choice by a condition among unrevealed cards of a secret area may be fewer.

printed_order.does: Steps and costs run top to bottom.

failed_if_stops_the_rest.does: Steps under an `if` that fails are not resolved.

turn_player_first.does: When both players choose or act at once, the turn player goes first.

conditions_checked_twice.does: [DON!! xN] and the turn conditions must hold when the timing is met and when the effect activates.

source_must_stay.does: An auto effect is dropped if its card has left its area before it activates.

looks_back.does: A card's own move off the field meets the timings of the abilities it had there: "when a Character is K.O.'d" is met by that Character's own K.O., and resolves from where the card went (card Q&A, EB01-047).

last_known.does: A pattern that reads a card as it was before it moved off the field reads its power, base power, cost, keywords, attributes and names as they were there at that moment, not as printed (card Q&A, OP14-053: a base power an effect set counts in the trash).

reach_read_with_itself.does: A permanent effect whose reach depends on the number it changes ("all of your Characters with a cost of 2 or more gain +1 cost") reads each card with the change applied to it: the card keeps the change only if it still fits, so a one-shot −3 on a card of cost 3 takes it to 1 and the +1 off, to 0, while a −2 leaves it at 2 with the +1 (card Q&A, OP10-042).

negation_read_without_itself.does: A permanent effect that negates cards by what they are ("other than {Roger Pirates} type cards") reads each card before that same negation: what the card's own text makes it, such as every type (PR-001), cannot be taken away by the negation it would spare the card from, so Gol.D.Roger (OP13-064) leaves the rainbow Monkey.D.Luffy Leader alone (Hunter, 16 October 2026). A negation from another source still takes it away (EB04-038).

cost_is_all_or_nothing.does: A cost that cannot be paid in full cannot be started.

alternative_cost_payable.does: Of alternative costs ("You may A or B:", `one_of` in a cost), only a mode that can be paid in full can be chosen; the cost can be paid when one of them can (card Q&A, OP17-020).

cost_where_it_went.does: The cost of an effect activated as its card moves (an [On K.O.], timings.yaml `cost_without_self`) is paid with the card where it went: it cannot rest itself, and a cost that picks from the trash may pick it (card Q&A, OP14-033, OP15-080).

cost_is_optional.does: The player is asked before the cost of an auto effect, of an Event's effect or of a [Trigger] is paid; declining means the effect does not activate. A cost printed without "You may" (`cost_required`) is not asked: it is paid when it can be, and when it cannot the effect does not activate (card Q&A, OP09-101). A [Trigger]'s cost is asked for after the card is revealed; declined, the effect does nothing and the card is trashed all the same. An [Activate: Main] effect and a [Blocker] are paid for by declaring them: choosing to use one is choosing to pay.

cost_replaced.does: A replacement may take the place of a step of a cost; the cost is then not paid as written, and the effect after the colon does not resolve.

cost_cut_short.does: A cost that becomes unpayable midway is paid as far as possible, the effect does not resolve, and a once-per-turn use is spent all the same.

once_per_turn.does: A use is recorded on the card when the effect has resolved, and forgotten when the card changes area.

mandatory_unless_may.does: An effect with no cost and no `may` always happens.

replacement_needs_all.does: A replacement whose `with` cannot be carried out in full cannot be applied.

nothing_to_act_on.does: A verb whose `needs` (verbs.yaml) fails has nothing to act on: no card is chosen for it, nothing is asked, and it does nothing. A `may` of that one step is not offered, so "if they do not" follows: Higuma (OP15-015) asks for no Character with no rested DON!! card to give it, and Amazon (OP15-059) asks no opponent without an active DON!! card whether they return one.

over_the_total_not_offered.does: A choice limited to a total cost of N or less does not offer a card whose own cost is over N: no cost is below 0, so no answer could hold it (Loki, OP17-119).

may_all_or_nothing.does: A `may` of several steps ("you may trash 1 card from your hand and rest 1 of your DON!! cards. If you do, ...") is offered only when each of them can be carried out in full, as a cost is; otherwise nothing is asked and nothing of it happens (card Q&A, OP11-024).

replacement_optional.does: A replacement marked optional asks its player first.

done_in_full.does: "If you do" (and "if they do not") reads a step with a fixed number as done only when it could be done in full as it started: with 1 card in the hand, "you may trash 2 cards. If you do, ..." trashes it and goes no further (card Q&A, OP15-020); "up to N" is done with any number.

replaced_is_not_done.does: What a replacement's steps change instead is not done by the step it replaced: "If you do" after that step reads only what the step itself did, so a return to the hand that another card's rest takes the place of is not done (card Q&A, OP13-119).

optional_auto.does: An auto effect marked optional ("This effect can be activated when ...") asks its player before it activates; declined, it does not activate, and a once-per-turn use is not spent (card Q&A, OP07-038).

activation_condition.does: An auto effect with a condition of its own (`if`: "If your Leader is [Shirahoshi], you may ...:", "This effect can be activated when you only have ...") activates only if the condition holds when it would activate, after the effects waiting before it: otherwise nothing is asked or paid and a once-per-turn use is not spent (card Q&A, OP11-043).

move_is_one_action.does: An action on several cards happens to all of them at once, and the effects it causes are collected together.

moved_card_is_spared.does: A card that a replacement of another card's event moves away while one move is being carried out is a new card there, and the move no longer takes it: a Character K.O.'d together with another, that returns itself to the hand to save the other, is not then K.O.'d from the hand (card Q&A, OP10-049).

owner_orders.does: When several cards go to an ordered secret area together, their owner chooses the order.

leader_stays.does: A card in an area marked `fixed` never leaves it.

given_don_is_apart.does: A filter matches cards given to a card only when it asks for their category, so a filter on the Character area finds Characters.

amount_read_per_card.does: An amount counted per DON!! card given (`per: don_count`) is read for each card the change applies to: a one-shot change made to several cards is one change per card, each fixed as it resolves ("−1000 power for every DON!! card given to that Character", OP15-008).

effects_end_on_move.does: Effects applied to a card end when it changes area.

effect_outlives_source.does: A lasting effect that has resolved stays in force when the card that made it leaves (general Q&A).

open_destination.does: A timing on a card's move is met only if the card arrives in an open area.

turn_player_first.does: The turn player's waiting effects resolve first, then the other player's.

player_orders_own.does: A player with several effects waiting chooses which resolves next.

replacements_in_order.does: When several replacement effects match one event: first those of the card that caused the event, then the turn player's, then the other player's. A player with several chooses which is applied, whether or not it says "you may"; once the event is replaced, no other applies to it (8-1-3-4-3).

new_effects_wait.does: An effect that starts waiting during that round resolves in the next round.

drained_after_step.does: Waiting effects resolve after each step of flow.yaml, after each player action, and where a procedure says `drain`; never in the middle of an effect. A [Trigger] is not a waiting effect: it runs inside damage processing (8-6-2-1). Effects of the damaged player that damage starts wait until that processing is over (8-6-2).

derived_values.does: If effects set the base power, or the base cost, the highest one applies.

If one-shot effects set the power itself, the latest one replaces it and every change made before that effect, permanent and rule effects included; only the changes made after it still add (card Q&A, OP07-002).
Add every plus and minus in force, rule effects included.
Power may be negative. A cost below 0 reads as 0.

waiting.engine.guarantees.secret_choice_may_be_f: No effect on file picks a fixed number by a condition from a hand or a deck.
waiting.engine.guarantees.leader_stays: The lint keeps every verb that moves a card away from the Leader area.
waiting.engine.guarantees.open_destination: No card on file has a timing on its own move into a secret area.
waiting.engine.questions.claim: Asked only in a match dealt with two locks (issue #19), which no scenario plays: the two-lock tests in packages/testkit run it.
waiting.flow.battle.joined@skip: No card on file moves a card of the battle when the battle's two cards are fixed (battle_joined); the Counter Step's own skip is run.

played.when: A Character or Stage card is placed in its area, from hand by the player or by an effect. `state` is how it would arrive: a prohibition on arriving active makes it arrive rested ("your Character cards are played rested", OP09-022).

ko.when: A Character is trashed by losing a battle or by an effect that says K.O.

rested.when: A card that was active becomes rested. `by` is the card whose effect or cost rested it: "a Character rested by your effect" (card Q&A, OP07-031).

set_active.when: A card that was rested becomes active. `by` is the card whose effect or cost set it active: "using Character effects" (card Q&A, OP10-030).

don_given.when: A DON!! card is given to a Leader or Character, by the action or by an effect: one event for each DON!! card. `card` is the card it is given to (OP02-002).

don_returned.when: A DON!! card on the field goes back to its owner's DON!! deck: one event for each card (OP02-071). `count`, on the first card's event only, is how many of that player's DON!! cards the same move returned: "when 2 or more DON!! cards ... are returned" is met once by one return of several, not by two returns of one (card Q&A, OP09-061).

life_moved.when: A Life card is moved by an effect or a cost: to the hand, the deck or the trash (`to`). Damage takes Life cards through life_taken instead.

removed.when: A card is returned to the hand, placed at the bottom of the deck, trashed or added to the Life cards by return_to_hand, place_at_bottom, trash or add_to_life, by an effect or as a cost (`cause`); `to` is where it goes. From the field this is a removal other than a K.O. (which is `ko`, 10-2-1-3); `card` is matched as it was, so a pattern names the area it leaves. A replacement can take its place: the card then stays, and a cost the move was part of is not paid as written (8-3-1-7; card Q&A, OP01-047).

life_removed.when: A card leaves a player's Life area, whatever moves it: damage, an effect or a cost; looking at the Life cards, turning them or putting them back in a new order is not it (card Q&A, OP08-105). `player` is the Life's owner. The move announces it by itself (`leaves`).

life_zero.when: A player's number of Life cards becomes 0: their last Life card has left, taken by damage or moved by an effect or a cost (OP05-098). It is announced as the card leaves, before a [Trigger] of that card is used.

trigger_activated.when: A [Trigger] is activated: its player has chosen to use it and revealed the card (OP05-109).

drawn.when: A card is drawn. `by` is the card whose effect drew it ("using your own effects", OP12-099).

trashed_from_hand.when: A card is trashed from a player's hand by an effect or a cost. `by` is the card whose effect or cost trashed it; `count`, on the first card's event only, is how many of that player's cards the same move trashed: "draw cards equal to the number of cards trashed" (OP12-040).

event_activated.when: An Event card is used from hand. Using a [Trigger] is not card activation.

attack_declared.when: The turn player has rested the attacker and named the target.

blocked.when: A [Blocker] has been activated and has taken the place of the target.

battle_joined.when: The two cards of a battle are fixed: the Block Step is over and the Counter Step begins. Emitted once for each card: `card` battles `against` (ST05-010).

battled.when: A battle has come through its Damage Step, the powers compared. Emitted once for each of the two cards: `card` battled `against`.

damage_dealt.when: Damage is dealt to a Leader. `player` is the one who takes it.

life_taken.when: One point of damage takes the top Life card. `to` is where it goes; `trigger` says whether its [Trigger] may be used.

life_to_hand.when: Damage adds the Life card it took to its owner's hand, its [Trigger] not used. A card its own [Trigger] puts in the hand is not one (card Q&A, OP05-107).

game_started.when: The game begins: after the players know who goes first and before the opening hands are drawn, once for each player, the player going first first (card Q&A, OP13-079). `player` is that player.

turn_started.when: A turn begins: the first thing of its Refresh Phase, before given DON!! cards go back and rested cards are set active. `player` is the turn player.

end_phase.when: The End Phase begins. `player` is the turn player.

defeat.when: A player has met a defeat condition and is about to lose.
